questions.text: How many lines of symmetry does a regular pentagon have?
questions.explanation: A regular polygon with 'n' sides has 'n' lines of symmetry. So, a regular pentagon has 5 lines of symmetry.

questions.text: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a square?
questions.explanation: A square looks exactly the same 4 times during one full 360-degree rotation (at 90, 180, 270, and 360 degrees).

questions.text: Which letter of the English alphabet has both horizontal and vertical line symmetry?
questions.explanation: Letters like H, I, O, and X can be divided into identical halves by both horizontal and vertical lines.
